what: FYI for the load-cargo deletion: as of 06:35 nothing in the main workspace names load_cargo or load-cargo (rg -l load_cargo:: crates fuzz finds only crates/blaze-wasm/src/pack/record.rs, and blaze-wasm is its own workspace; blaze-expand and blaze-engine are off it). integrate-vfs deletes vfs + vfs-notify in one step right after load-cargo goes (load-cargo is the last user of v1 vfs::Vfs, vfs::loader and vfs-notify), so a DELETED load-cargo line in your report unblocks it. Note when deleting: Cargo.lock orphans that go with load-cargo+vfs-notify (notify, walkdir, ...) I prune in my step; leave them.
